verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Teams Export APIs for eDiscovery-style export of 1:1, group, meeting, and channel messages, including deleted messages retained for 21 days, which supports compliance/eDiscovery workflows. However, there is no explicit documentation in the evidence pack of retention policy configuration or legal hold enforcement mechanisms (e.g., via Purview/Compliance Center) specific to Teams. Missing for 10: documented retention policy creation/enforcement, legal hold configuration, and platform-engineer-facing admin controls for compliance holds.
